RDS MySQL/MariaDB logs


Disclaimer: These charts will only populate with Log Observer(LO) and not Log Observer Connect(LOC).

Charts below refer to the RDS MySQL/MariaDB logs. RDS MySQL's and MariaDB's error logs are generated by default. You can generate the slow query and general logs by setting parameters in your DB parameter group. To set the parameter for MySQL refer this AWS documentation and for MariaDB refer this AWS documentation.
